verdict.rationale: Anrok's own pricing page claims managed filing and remittance ("Filing and payments, done for you"). The API docs show transactions are associated with tax returns and that filings can be fetched, so the core prepare-file-remit capability is the product's own. However, nothing in the pack documents on-time guarantees, coverage across every registered jurisdiction, or a vendor guarantee covering late-filing penalties. Missing for 10: late-filing penalty guarantee, on-time filing commitment, explicit coverage of all registered jurisdictions for filing, in-depth filing workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, returns are prepared, filed, and remitted automatically in every registered jurisdiction — on time, with the vendor's guarantee covering penalties if it files late
